---
title: "KNN"
output: html_document
---

# Loading in the cleaned and split data
```{r}
madness_train <- readRDS("training_data.rds")
madness_test <- readRDS("testing_data.rds")
```

# Preparing the data
```{r}
# Separate predictors and outcome
X_train <- subset(madness_train, select = -winner)
X_test <- subset(madness_test, select = -winner)

knn_train_labels <- as.factor(madness_train$winner)
knn_test_labels <- as.factor(madness_test$winner)

# Normalize predictors to 0–1
normalize <- function(x) {(x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))}

knn_train <- as.data.frame(lapply(X_train, normalize))
knn_test <- as.data.frame(lapply(X_test, normalize))

# Check normalized predictors
summary(knn_train)
```

# Running Model
```{r}

# Use the square root of the number of training rows as the number of nearest neighbors
k_start <- round(sqrt(nrow(knn_train)))

library(class)

madness_test_pred_knn <- knn(
  train = knn_train,
  test = knn_test,
  cl = knn_train_labels,
  k = k_start
)

```

# Prediction and Evaluation
```{r}

knn_results <- list(
  prediction = madness_test_pred_knn,
  actual = knn_test_labels
)

library(caret)
knn_confusion <- confusionMatrix(
  as.factor(knn_results$prediction),
  as.factor(knn_results$actual),
  positive = "1"
)

knn_confusion
```

# Improving the model 
```{r}

# Try odd k values from 1 to the square root of the training set size
k_values <- seq(1, round(sqrt(nrow(knn_train))), by = 2)

knn_accuracy <- data.frame(k = k_values, accuracy = NA_real_)

for (i in seq_along(k_values)) {
  pred <- knn(
    train = knn_train,
    test = knn_test,
    cl = knn_train_labels,
    k = k_values[i]
  )

  cm <- confusionMatrix(
    data = factor(pred, levels = levels(knn_test_labels)),
    reference = knn_test_labels,
    positive = "1"
  )

  knn_accuracy$accuracy[i] <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
}

knn_accuracy
best_k <- knn_accuracy$k[which.max(knn_accuracy$accuracy)]
best_k

```

# Final model
```{r}


madness_final_knn <- knn(
  train = knn_train,
  test = knn_test,
  cl = knn_train_labels,
  k = best_k
)

knn_results_final <- list(
  prediction = madness_final_knn,
  actual = knn_test_labels
)

library(caret)
knn_confusion_final <- confusionMatrix(
  as.factor(knn_results_final$prediction),
  as.factor(knn_results_final$actual),
  positive = "1"
)

knn_confusion_final


```

# Saving relevant data files
```{r}

saveRDS(knn_results_final$prediction, "knn_predictions.rds")
saveRDS(knn_confusion_final, "knn_confusion_matrix.rds")


```
